summary: Producer of an opaque, concentrated milk product flowing through a processing line currently samples for fat and protein analysis and wants earlier information about composition changes. Temperature and texture vary during production. They request an initial spectroscopy concept and a practical comparison experiment while retaining laboratory checks.
